thread:
incident-bot: sev2 pager: canopy-inference cluster experiencing elevated 5xx (502/503) for ~6m, error rate ~12% on region-us-west. paging oncall @maya_oncall. details: https://ops.redwood.internal/alerts/2555554321 :rotating_light:

maya_oncall: got it, ack. jumping onto bridge now — sharing join link in 30s. can someone grab customer impact?

raj_sre: seeing backend pool N77 with sudden queue growth, KV cache evictions spike. no deploys in last 20m. temporary mitigation: increasing worker replica target to 6 and enabling fallback-model routing.

alex_runtime: rerouting to smaller model variant applied + prefix cache bypass for current sessions. adding `--max-concurrency=2` to bridge nodes to reduce tail latency.

maya_oncall: join link: https://meet.redwood/incident-2555554321. oncall takeover: maya -> raj after stabilize.

claire_pm: hitting customer-facing 502s on core inference route; estimated affected requests ~10-14% of overall. flagged to account teams. any known paid-customer errors?

raj_sre: quick query: `SELECT count(*) FROM request_logs WHERE status>=500 AND ts>now()-interval '10 minutes'` returns ~1.2k errors, top 3 customers by volume listed in the incident doc. ops notes pinned.

deploy-bot: rollout check: last production deploy 2555554200 by alex_runtime — no canary changes to inference runtime.

maya_oncall: mitigation in progress: worker replicas up, failover routing on. monitoring latency and error rate. ETA ~10-15m to confirm recovery.

raj_sre: error rate down to 2.3% after routing, latency normalized for majority. opening post-incident thread for follow-up: will schedule postmortem if error >1% for 30m or customer impact >5%.

claire_pm: customer-impact ask: propose PM-led comms for top 3 customers in next 2 hours if final numbers hold.

alex_runtime: notes to include in postmortem: KV cache eviction threshold tuning, fallback routing logic, and a short-term patch to avoid aggressive prefix cache invalidation. command to collect logs: ```curl -s "https://logstash.redwood/api/search?query=cluster:N77 AND status:5*" > /tmp/255555_logs.json```

maya_oncall: marking incident as live-mitigated. creating immediate action items now and will hand off to remediation after 2pm PST.

maya_oncall: ACTIONS (quick triage, assign owners):
- maya_oncall: confirm SLA impact calc + write customer comms draft (est 2h)
- raj_sre: KV-cache eviction root-cause analysis + mitigation PR (estimate: medium, 3d)
- alex_runtime: implement safe-rollback for prefix-cache toggles + canary test (small, 2d)
- eng-infra: add richer telemetry for queue growth (large, 2w)

claire_pm: OKRs / quarterly tie-in: suggest we prioritize KV-cache eviction fixes in Q2 reliability sprint; mark eng-infra telemetry as Q3 platform investment.

raj_sre: will create JIRA tickets now and include labels: incident-2555554321, sev2, postmortem-required. plz add estimates as days.

maya_oncall: scheduling postmortem check: Tue 10am PT (tentative) — will send calendar if confirmed. target outputs: timeline, root cause, action items with owners + SLO impact calc.

claire_pm: to prioritize: order by customer-impact then time-to-fix. KV fix first (affects multiple customers), runtime rollback second, telemetry third.

alex_runtime: quick note — add fallback-policy test harness to CI so we can validate routing changes pre-deploy (tiny spike in effort, low risk).

maya_oncall: handoff to raj_sre for root-cause deeper dive. I'll update incident record and close pager when we hit steady state. thanks all :white_check_mark:

raj_sre: taking post-incident ownership. will post preliminary RCA draft in 24h and link remediation tickets.

incident-bot: incident transitioned to "post-mitigation" state by maya_oncall at 2555554360.
